scope: front/ standalone; src + public JS/JSX/TS/TSX; no dependencies/build/coverage/tool configuration
methodology: Guide 28/10/2026 §4.5: comments/imports/JSX-tag/control-only lines removed, whitespace normalized, file-local five-line windows, unique affected lines; TypeScript AST locates functions/classes, regex estimates complexity
limitations: Not the official analyzer; its full regexes are unavailable
TypeScript scanner comment removal has edge cases with regex/template literals
Complexity regex can match branch words inside strings and nested functions
Callbacks and constructors included; official function detection may differ
Cohesion uses directly shared fields and does not follow hook delegation
CBO identifiers include framework decorators/interfaces and constants; manual review required
Vistas counts files, including tests, exactly as §4.7 describes
LOC includes tests and excludes docs/CSS/config as §4.3 describes

layers.limitation: Layer matching by directory name, as §4.7 describes; exact official matcher unavailable
